# LoadPR

> Load your barbell right, instantly

LoadPR is an iPhone app that works out which plates to load on a barbell and tracks your personal records (PRs). This site adds free browser calculators for loading a barbell in kilograms or pounds: a plate calculator, a home gym plate calculator for the plates you own, a one-rep max (1RM) calculator, a 1RM percentage calculator, a warmup calculator, a kg to lb converter and a "what's on the bar" calculator that adds up a loaded barbell. The app is free to download, with optional in-app purchases. Contact: support@loadpr.com.

## English (en)

### Home
- [LoadPR — Load your barbell right, instantly](https://loadpr.com/): Free barbell calculators: plates per side, 1RM, warmup sets and kg ↔ lb conversion. No signup. Get LoadPR for iOS and load your bar right at the gym.

### Tools
- [Plate Calculator | How Many Plates Per Side](https://loadpr.com/plate-calculator/): Instantly work out which plates to load per side. Free, no signup. Get LoadPR for iOS and take it to the gym.
- [1RM Calculator | Estimate Your Max](https://loadpr.com/1rm-calculator/): Estimate your one-rep max with Epley, Brzycki, Lombardi and O'Conner formulas, plus a 50-100% percentage table.
- [Warmup Calculator | Progressive Sets](https://loadpr.com/warmup-calculator/): Generate progressive warmup sets from your working weight, rounded to loadable plates.
- [Kg to Lb Converter | Kilos to Pounds](https://loadpr.com/kg-to-lb/): Convert kilograms to pounds and back, with rounding to the nearest loadable plate.
- [1RM Percentage Calculator | Training Loads](https://loadpr.com/1rm-percentage-calculator/): Turn your one-rep max into a percentage chart from 100% down to 50%, with every weight rounded to a load you can put on the bar.
- [What's on the Bar? Loaded Barbell Weight](https://loadpr.com/whats-on-the-bar/): Count the plates on one side of a loaded barbell and get the total weight in kg and lb, with the bar and collars included.
- [Home Gym Plate Calculator | Use Your Own Plates](https://loadpr.com/home-gym-plate-calculator/): Enter the plates you own and a target weight. Get the exact load with the fewest plates, or the closest you can get and the pair to add if one pair does it.
- [Barbell Tools: Plates, 1RM, Warmups, kg to lb](https://loadpr.com/tools/): Every free LoadPR web tool on one page: plates per side, 1RM, percentages, warmup sets, kg to lb, what's on the bar and home gym plates.

### App features
- [LoadPR App Features for iPhone and Apple Watch](https://loadpr.com/features/): What LoadPR does on iPhone and Apple Watch: plate loading, gyms and plates, percentages, PR tracking, charts, timers, and what is free.
- [Plate Loading App for iPhone: See the Bar](https://loadpr.com/features/plate-loading/): LoadPR draws one side of the barbell with the plates to load, color-coded, in lb or kg. Free to use with no limit, on iPhone and Apple Watch.
- [Closest Loadable Weight on a Barbell](https://loadpr.com/features/closest-loadable-weight/): When a weight like 187.5 lb can't be built from your plates, LoadPR shows the closest weight you can load, with the plates for each side.
- [Percentages of Your PR, Loaded on the Bar](https://loadpr.com/features/percentages/): Turn LoadPR's wheel from 50% to 120% of your current PR, or of any weight you type, and see a weight you can load with the plates for each side.
- [Gym Plate Setup: Your Bar and Your Plates](https://loadpr.com/features/gyms-and-plates/): LoadPR's free version uses the standard lb or kg plates, two of each per side. With LoadPR+, save each gym's bar, its plates and how many you own.
- [PR Tracker for Lifting: Log Every Best](https://loadpr.com/features/pr-tracking/): Log each PR in LoadPR with its weight, reps, date and a note. See the current PR of every lift and its history, with up to 5 lifts in the free version.
- [Strength Progress Chart for Each Lift](https://loadpr.com/features/progress-charts/): Chart every PR in LoadPR: your singles and the estimated 1RM of sets of more reps, from 7 days to all time. A mini chart of your last 3 singles is free.
- [Gym Workout Timer: Rest, EMOM, HIIT, AMRAP](https://loadpr.com/features/workout-timer/): LoadPR's Rest timer is free and counts down on the lock screen between sets. EMOM, HIIT and AMRAP interval timers come with LoadPR+.
- [Apple Watch Plate Calculator and % Dial](https://loadpr.com/features/apple-watch/): Pick a lift on Apple Watch, turn the Digital Crown from 50% to 120% of your best single, and see the weight and the plates for one side of the bar.

### Guides
- [Barbell & Plate Guides](https://loadpr.com/guide/): Guides for lifters: plates on each side, what a plate and a barbell weigh, Olympic vs standard plates, plate colors and kg to lb equivalents.
- [Olympic Plate Colors \(IWF\)](https://loadpr.com/guide/olympic-plate-colors/): What each Olympic plate color means under the IWF standard: 25 kg red, 20 kg blue, 15 kg yellow, 10 kg green, plus the change plates.
- [How Much Does a Barbell Weigh? 45 lb / 20 kg](https://loadpr.com/guide/barbell-weights/): A gym barbell weighs 45 lb \(20 kg\). Women's Olympic bar 33 lb \(15 kg\), EZ curl 15–25 lb, trap bar 45–60 lb, safety squat bar 55–70 lb and more.
- [Kg to Lb Equivalents for Lifting](https://loadpr.com/guide/kg-to-lb-equivalents/): Conversion table between kilograms and pounds for the most common training loads.
- [How Much Is 1 to 6 Plates on Each Side?](https://loadpr.com/guide/plates-on-each-side/): 1 plate on each side is 135 lb, 2 plates 225 lb, 3 plates 315 lb and 4 plates 405 lb on a 45 lb bar. In kg, 2 × 20 kg plates per side make 100 kg.
- [How Much Does a Plate Weigh? 45 lb = 20.41 kg](https://loadpr.com/guide/how-much-does-a-plate-weigh/): A standard gym plate weighs 45 lb \(20.41 kg\) in a pound gym, or 20 kg \(44.09 lb\) in a kilo gym. Every plate from 1.25 kg to 45 lb in both units.
- [Olympic vs Standard Plates: The Difference](https://loadpr.com/guide/olympic-vs-standard-plates/): Olympic plates have a 2-inch \(50 mm\) hole for 45 lb Olympic bars; standard plates have a 1-inch hole for lighter 15–25 lb bars. Same weight, other bar.
- [How Much Do Barbell Collars Weigh? 2.5 kg Each](https://loadpr.com/guide/barbell-collar-weight/): Competition collars weigh 2.5 kg \(5.51 lb\) each, so a pair adds 5 kg \(11.02 lb\). Spring clips and lock-jaw collars depend on the model.
- [What Is a 1RM? One-Rep Max Explained](https://loadpr.com/guide/what-is-1rm/): A 1RM is the most weight you can lift for one full rep with good form. Tested vs estimated maxes, how it differs from a rep PR, and why programs use it.
- [What Is a PR in the Gym? Personal Record Meaning](https://loadpr.com/guide/what-is-a-pr/): PR means personal record: the heaviest weight you have lifted for a given number of reps. Weight PRs vs rep PRs, how to find yours and how to track them.
- [1RM Formulas: Epley, Brzycki, Lombardi, O'Conner](https://loadpr.com/guide/how-to-calculate-1rm/): A 1RM is estimated by putting a set of a few reps into a formula. Epley, Brzycki, Lombardi and O'Conner side by side, and why they split above 10 reps.
- [Rep Max Chart: % of 1RM for 1 to 12 Reps](https://loadpr.com/guide/rep-max-chart/): A rep max chart turns reps into a % of your 1RM: 5 reps is about 85.7% by Epley and 88.9% by Brzycki. Full 1 to 12 rep table with kg and lb examples.
- [How to Test Your 1RM Safely](https://loadpr.com/guide/how-to-test-your-1rm/): Work up in singles at 50, 70, 80, 90 and 95% of a planned max, then take 100%. Attempt tables for 140 kg and 315 lb, plus spotter and safety basics.
- [How Many Warm-Up Sets for Squat, Bench, Deadlift?](https://loadpr.com/guide/warm-up-sets/): Most lifters need 3 to 5 warm-up sets. A simple ramp is 40, 60, 75 and 85% of the work set: 125, 190, 235 and 270 lb before 315 lb, with the plates.
- [5/3/1 Training Max: 90% or 85% of Your 1RM](https://loadpr.com/guide/531-training-max/): Your 5/3/1 training max is 90% of your 1RM \(85% in later books\). A 455 lb max gives a 409.5 lb TM, so the 85% set is 350 lb, not 386.75 lb.
- [Why Can't I Load an Exact Weight on a Barbell?](https://loadpr.com/guide/cant-load-exact-weight/): The bar moves in steps of twice your smallest plate: 5 lb with 2.5s, 2.5 kg with 1.25s. How to round 172 lb or 102 kg, and when microplates help.

## Español (es)

### Home
- [LoadPR — Calcula los discos de tu barra al instante](https://loadpr.com/es/): Calculadoras gratis para la barra: discos por lado, 1RM, series de calentamiento y conversión kg ↔ lb. Sin registro. Lleva LoadPR para iOS al gimnasio.

### Tools
- [Calculadora de discos | Cuántos discos por lado](https://loadpr.com/es/calculadora-de-discos/): Calcula al instante qué discos poner por lado en tu barra. Gratis, sin registro. Descarga LoadPR para iOS y llévalo al gimnasio.
- [Calculadora 1RM | Estima tu máximo](https://loadpr.com/es/calculadora-1rm/): Estima tu 1RM con las fórmulas Epley, Brzycki, Lombardi y O'Conner, y obtén la tabla de porcentajes del 50 al 100%.
- [Calculadora de calentamiento | Series progresivas](https://loadpr.com/es/calculadora-calentamiento/): Genera tus series de calentamiento progresivas a partir del peso de trabajo, redondeadas a discos reales.
- [Conversor kg a lb | Kilos a libras](https://loadpr.com/es/conversor-kg-lb/): Convierte kilogramos a libras y viceversa, con redondeo al disco cargable más cercano.
- [Porcentajes del 1RM | Tabla de cargas](https://loadpr.com/es/calculadora-porcentajes-1rm/): Convierte tu repetición máxima en una tabla de porcentajes del 100 al 50%, con cada peso redondeado a una carga que puedes montar en la barra.
- [¿Cuánto pesa la barra cargada? | Calculadora](https://loadpr.com/es/cuanto-pesa-la-barra-cargada/): Cuenta los discos de un lado de la barra y obtén el peso total en kg y lb, con la barra y los collarines incluidos.
- [Calculadora de discos para casa | Usa tus discos](https://loadpr.com/es/calculadora-discos-casa/): Indica los discos que tienes y el peso objetivo. Verás la carga exacta con el menor número de discos, o la más cercana y, si basta un par, cuál añadir.
- [Herramientas de barra: discos, 1RM, calentamiento](https://loadpr.com/es/herramientas/): Todas las herramientas web gratis de LoadPR en una página: discos por lado, 1RM, porcentajes, calentamiento, kg a lb, barra cargada y discos en casa.

### Guides
- [Guías de barras y discos](https://loadpr.com/es/guia/): Guías para levantadores: colores de los discos olímpicos, cuánto pesa cada barra y equivalencias de kg a libras para cargar bien la barra.
- [Colores de los discos olímpicos \(IWF\)](https://loadpr.com/es/guia/colores-discos-olimpicos/): Qué significa cada color de disco olímpico según la IWF: 25 kg rojo, 20 kg azul, 15 kg amarillo, 10 kg verde y las placas de cambio.
- [¿Cuánto pesa una barra? Olímpica, Z/EZ y en libras](https://loadpr.com/es/guia/peso-de-barras/): La barra olímpica pesa 20 kg \(45 lb\) y la femenina 15 kg \(33 lb\). La barra Z, EZ o W pesa entre 7 y 11 kg \(15–25 lb\). Tabla en kilos y libras de cada barra.
- [100 kg en libras \(220,46 lb\) y tabla kg ↔ lb](https://loadpr.com/es/guia/equivalencias-kg-lb/): 100 kg son 220,46 libras \(1 kg = 2,2046 lb\). Tabla de equivalencias kg ↔ lb para las cargas habituales y cómo cargar 100 kg en la barra.

## Français (fr)

### Home
- [LoadPR — Chargez votre barre sans vous tromper](https://loadpr.com/fr/): Calculateurs gratuits pour la barre : disques par côté, 1RM, échauffement et conversion kg ↔ lb. Sans inscription. LoadPR sur iOS vous suit à la salle.

### Tools
- [Calcul de disques | Combien de disques par côté](https://loadpr.com/fr/calculateur-de-disques/): Calculez instantanément quels disques mettre de chaque côté de votre barre. Gratuit, sans inscription. Téléchargez LoadPR pour iOS et emportez-le à la salle.
- [Calculateur 1RM | Estimez votre max](https://loadpr.com/fr/calculateur-1rm/): Estimez votre 1RM avec les formules Epley, Brzycki, Lombardi et O'Conner, et obtenez le tableau des pourcentages de 50 à 100 %.
- [Calculateur d'échauffement | Séries progressives](https://loadpr.com/fr/calculateur-echauffement/): Générez vos séries d'échauffement progressives à partir de votre poids de travail, arrondies à des disques réels.
- [Convertisseur kg en lb | Kilos en livres](https://loadpr.com/fr/convertisseur-kg-lb/): Convertissez les kilogrammes en livres et inversement, avec arrondi au disque chargeable le plus proche.
- [Pourcentages du 1RM | Tableau des charges](https://loadpr.com/fr/calculateur-pourcentage-1rm/): Transformez votre répétition maximale en tableau de pourcentages de 100 à 50 %, chaque poids arrondi à une charge réalisable sur la barre.
- [Combien pèse la barre chargée ? | Calculateur](https://loadpr.com/fr/poids-sur-la-barre/): Comptez les disques d'un côté de la barre et obtenez le poids total en kg et en lb, barre et colliers compris.
- [Disques à la maison | Chargez avec vos disques](https://loadpr.com/fr/calculateur-disques-maison/): Indiquez vos disques et le poids visé. Obtenez la charge exacte avec le moins de disques, ou la plus proche et, si une paire suffit, laquelle ajouter.
- [Outils barre : disques, 1RM, échauffement, kg en lb](https://loadpr.com/fr/outils/): Tous les outils web gratuits de LoadPR sur une page : disques par côté, 1RM, pourcentages, échauffement, kg en lb, barre chargée et disques maison.

### Guides
- [Guides barres et disques](https://loadpr.com/fr/guide/): Guides pour la musculation : couleurs des disques olympiques, poids de chaque barre et équivalences kg en livres pour bien charger la barre.
- [Couleurs des disques olympiques \(IWF\)](https://loadpr.com/fr/guide/couleurs-disques-olympiques/): Ce que signifie chaque couleur de disque olympique selon l'IWF : 25 kg rouge, 20 kg bleu, 15 kg jaune, 10 kg vert et les disques d'ajustement.
- [Poids des barres de musculation](https://loadpr.com/fr/guide/poids-des-barres/): Poids de la barre olympique masculine \(20 kg\), féminine \(15 kg\), des barres techniques, EZ, hexagonales et plus encore.
- [Équivalences kg en livres pour la musculation](https://loadpr.com/fr/guide/equivalences-kg-lb/): Tableau d'équivalences entre kilogrammes et livres pour les charges d'entraînement les plus courantes.

### Tools
- [Scheibenrechner | Wie viele Scheiben pro Seite](https://loadpr.com/de/scheibenrechner/): Berechne sofort, welche Scheiben auf jede Seite gehören. Kostenlos, ohne Anmeldung. Hol dir LoadPR für iOS und nimm es mit ins Studio.

- [Kg in Lb umrechnen | Kilo in Pfund](https://loadpr.com/de/kg-in-lb-umrechnen/): Rechne Kilogramm in Pfund um und zurück, gerundet auf die nächste Scheibe, die du wirklich laden kannst.

- [Wie viel liegt auf der Stange? Gesamtgewicht](https://loadpr.com/de/gewicht-auf-der-stange/): Zähl die Scheiben auf einer Seite einer beladenen Langhantel und erhalte das Gesamtgewicht in kg und lb, Stange und Verschlüsse inklusive.
- [Heimstudio-Scheibenrechner | Deine eigenen Scheiben](https://loadpr.com/de/heimstudio-scheibenrechner/): Gib deine Scheiben und ein Zielgewicht ein: exakte Beladung mit den wenigsten Scheiben oder das nächste Gewicht, plus das fehlende Paar, falls eines reicht.

- [ホームジムのプレート計算｜手持ちのプレートで](https://loadpr.com/ja/home-gym-plate-keisan/): 持っているプレートと目標重量を入力。最少枚数でぴったりの組み合わせを表示し、無理なら最も近い重量と、1ペアで届く場合は追加すべきペアも表示します。

- [1RM 计算器｜估算你的最大重量](https://loadpr.com/zh-hans/1rm-jisuanqi/): 用 Epley、Brzycki、Lombardi 和 O'Conner 公式估算你的 1RM（单次最大重量），并附上 50–100% 的百分比表，方便安排训练重量。
- [热身组计算器｜循序渐进的热身组](https://loadpr.com/zh-hans/reshen-zu-jisuan/): 根据你的正式组重量生成循序渐进的热身组，每一组都会取整到用杠铃片能挂出的重量，进健身房就能直接照着练。

- [1RM 百分比计算器｜训练重量表](https://loadpr.com/zh-hans/1rm-baifenbi/): 把你的 1RM 变成一张从 100% 到 50% 的百分比表，每个重量都会取整到你能实际挂上杠铃的重量，训练时一目了然。
- [杠上有多重？已挂片杠铃总重](https://loadpr.com/zh-hans/gangling-zhongliang/): 数一数已挂片杠铃一侧的杠铃片，即可得到包含杠铃杆和卡扣在内的总重量，同时以 kg 和 lb 两种单位显示。
- [家庭健身房杠铃片计算器｜用你自己的片](https://loadpr.com/zh-hans/jiating-jianshen-gangling-pian/): 输入你拥有的杠铃片和目标重量，用最少的片数精确挂出；挂不出时显示最接近的重量，如果只差一对，还会告诉你该补哪一对。

- [LoadPR — 槓鈴上片，一秒算對](https://loadpr.com/zh-hant/): 免費槓鈴計算工具：每邊上幾片、1RM、熱身組和 kg ↔ lb 換算，不必註冊。下載 iOS 版 LoadPR，在健身房也能把槓片上對。

### Tools
- [槓片計算機｜每邊要上幾片](https://loadpr.com/zh-hant/gangpian-jisuanji/): 立即算出槓鈴每邊要上哪些槓片。免費使用，不必註冊。下載 iOS 版 LoadPR，帶著它去健身房，每次都能把重量上對。
- [1RM 計算機｜估算你的最大重量](https://loadpr.com/zh-hant/1rm-jisuanji/): 用 Epley、Brzycki、Lombardi 和 O'Conner 公式估算你的 1RM（單次最大重量），並附上 50–100% 的百分比表，方便安排訓練重量。
- [熱身組計算機｜循序漸進的熱身組](https://loadpr.com/zh-hant/reshen-zu-jisuan/): 依照你的正式組重量產生循序漸進的熱身組，每一組都會取整到用槓片組得出來的重量，到了健身房就能直接照著練。
- [公斤磅換算｜kg 與 lb 互換](https://loadpr.com/zh-hant/gongjin-bang-huansuan/): 把公斤換算成磅，或把磅換算成公斤，結果會取整到最接近的可上片槓片重量，讓你輕鬆看懂另一種單位寫的課表。
- [1RM 百分比計算機｜訓練重量表](https://loadpr.com/zh-hant/1rm-baifenbi/): 把你的 1RM 變成一張從 100% 到 50% 的百分比表，每個重量都會取整到你實際上得了槓的重量，訓練時一目了然。
- [槓上有多重？已上片槓鈴總重](https://loadpr.com/zh-hant/gangling-zhongliang/): 數一數已上片槓鈴一側的槓片，就能算出包含槓鈴和卡扣在內的總重量，並同時以 kg 和 lb 兩種單位顯示。
- [居家健身房槓片計算機｜用你自己的槓片](https://loadpr.com/zh-hant/jujia-jianshen-gangpian/): 輸入你擁有的槓片和目標重量，用最少片數精準組出；組不出時顯示最接近的重量，如果只差一對，還會告訴你該補哪一對。
- [槓鈴工具：槓片、1RM、熱身、kg-lb 換算](https://loadpr.com/zh-hant/gongju/): LoadPR 的所有免費網頁工具都在這裡：每邊槓片、1RM、百分比、熱身組、kg-lb 換算、槓上有多重，以及居家健身房槓片。

### Plate charts by weight
- [How many plates for 40 to 300 kg (105 pages, one per weight)](https://loadpr.com/zh-hant/gangpian/40-kg/): URL pattern https://loadpr.com/zh-hant/gangpian/<weight>-kg/
